description: Add blood pressure 124/78 mmHg on exam
presentation: A 34-year-old man presents for follow-up after an emergency department visit for palpitations, tachycardia, arm numbness, and a sensation of tightness in the neck, thought to be due to stress/anxiety as he has been getting poor sleep due to international travel and jet lag. On exam, his blood pressure is 124/78 mmHg. He had a negative troponin, normal TSH, and normal A1c, but his LDL was 200. What interventions should be done for this patient?
